name: mirage
text: Partly. The app's management key can list your subaccounts and move money in and out of the Vigilant one (fund/defund), and that's how the $1,078 in / $631 out figures are known. But the API documentation I have shows no way to read the main account's own balance, bets or history outside the subaccounts. Each subaccount's ledger and balance are readable by its key. I haven't tested this against your live account, and I won't (it's your management key, which stays on your phone). If you want the whole picture, the Novig app's own transaction history for the main account would show it.
